messages:
alex_peopleops: Hey team — quick help needed. Employee Maria reached out: she had a kinship placement (16yo niece) on 2024-10-15 and wants to add her to medical/dental retro to 10/15. She has a county placement letter and an email from the caseworker dated 2024-10-20. She says she tried to upload earlier but scanner issues. Can we accept those docs and process retro enrollment? cc @jordan @sam_benefits @maya_payroll

jordan: Quick checklist — for kinship we accept either a court placement order OR a county/caseworker placement letter plus proof of address. Retro enrollments typically require notification within 30 days of the QLE. Do we know when she first notified HR/benefits?

alex_peopleops: She says she attempted to notify on 2024-10-18 but couldn't upload the PDF until now. She has an email thread with the caseworker (timestamps) and the placement letter PDF. Asking if we can make a good-faith exception if docs show the earlier notification.

sam_benefits: Policy: employees must request enrollment within 30 days of the QLE to get retro effective date. If there is an email thread from the caseworker dated within 30 days that demonstrates intent, we can triage as a standard retro QLE. Ask Maria to upload: 1) placement letter or order, 2) caseworker email with dates, 3) proof of residence (mail or school registration). We'll review and confirm effective date.

maya_payroll: If benefits team approves retro effective 2024-10-15, payroll will prorate premiums back to that date and process an adjustment. Need Maria's employee/payroll ID to do the retro calculation. Note: if the 10/15 pay-period has already closed, adjustment will show as a separate line on next pay cycle.

jordan: Also flag that dependent status can affect FSA/HSA election options — if she wants to enroll the dependent in flexible spending account, she'll need to update elections. We'll include that in the approval note.

alex_peopleops: Okay I'll ask Maria to upload docs and provide payroll ID. Any specific upload link or subject line we want her to use?

hr_bot: Reminder: do NOT post scanned PHI in public channels. Use the secure benefits upload form or the private HR ticket. See https://hr.redwood/upload for the secure upload link.

jordan: Confirmed docs list for upload: - placement/custody order OR county placement letter - caseworker email with date stamps - proof of residence (school record, mail with address) Upload securely here: https://hr.redwood/upload/4931 — we'll triage within 3 business days :thumbsup:

maria_g: Thanks everyone — uploading now. My payroll ID is 54876. Also one quick Q: on the benefits form there's a tobacco question — do I mark the teen as 'no'? They do not use tobacco.

sam_benefits: Mark as 'no' for tobacco if the dependent does not use tobacco. We'll verify during doc review.

maya_payroll: Got it — once docs approved I'll post the retro premium amount and timeline here.

alex_peopleops: Appreciate it — I'll keep thread updated after docs land and benefits triage. Thanks all!
